entries.name: FHIR R5 machine-readable resource definitions

entries.name: SNOMED CT International Edition
entries.versionBasis: Licensing/access page checked; no entitled release archive inspected, so no invented monthly latest version.

licence.text: SNOMED CT Affiliate License Agreement / territorial licensing
licence.basis: Free use in member territories does not establish unrestricted redistribution. Affiliate, deployment territory and recipient entitlements must be checked before any distribution.

entries.name: WHO ICD-11 classification through ICD API
entries.versionBasis: WHO supported-classification table explicitly identifies release 2026-01, including Arabic ICD-11 MMS. Exact publication day remains unverified; API software version is not classification version.

licence.text: CC-BY-ND-3.0-IGO for ICD-11 classifications; separate software terms
licence.basis: WHO terms permit attributed incorporation retaining classification codes and URIs; adaptations/renaming or stripped identifiers are restricted. Do not infer permission to publish a remodelled ontology.

norn.overlap: Disease/classification identifiers only; preserve source hierarchy and identifiers rather than promote to Core.

priority.reason: Industry vertical outside the ERP core; later.

entries.notes: License evidence is PDF but classification is an API corpus, so this is not a PDF-only source. ICD-10/national modifications require separate version and rights investigation; no inferred shared license. Redistribution: license-conditions.
